scope: Per-row and pair semantic audit only; these are criterion excerpts, not complete task rubrics. Do not flag unshown coverage. All sources/capabilities given here are established fixture facts.

cases.prompt: Compare the themed UK iOS alpha D1 with its quoted scale target. Record your conclusion in existing Orbit project materials and notify the team.
sources: The themed UK iOS alpha D1 was about 34%; the quoted target is at least 45%.
Existing Orbit materials include the Orbit proposal presentation and ORB-1 master ticket. Either is editable by the assigned persona.
The team can be reached through the Orbit Slack channel or its mailing list.

criteria.title: The Agent reports that the themed UK iOS alpha D1 of approximately 34% is below the quoted 45% scale target.
criteria.justification: The prompt asks for the comparison.
criteria.evidence: Inspect the recorded comparison or report.

cases.prompt: Record the recommendation in existing Orbit materials.
sources: The Orbit proposal presentation and ORB-1 master ticket are both existing, editable project materials.

criteria.title: The Agent records the recommendation in the ORB-1 master ticket.
criteria.justification: The master ticket is existing Orbit material.
criteria.evidence: Inspect the new content on ORB-1.

cases.prompt: Report the current App Store download size.
sources: The current size is 214 MB. No output formatting instruction was provided.

criteria.title: The Agent reports the current App Store download size as exactly 214.0 MB with one decimal place.
criteria.justification: The prompt asks for the size.

cases.prompt: Explain whether the themed build monetization results transfer to Lite.
sources: Lite removes the card/collection meta used for themed-build monetization, so monetization results are not directly comparable.

criteria.title: The Agent explains that removal of the card/collection meta makes monetization results not directly comparable between the themed and Lite builds.

cases.prompt: Ask Maya whether the scale target uses calendar-day or rolling-24-hour D1.
sources: Maya is the target owner. Either direct mail or Slack can reach her.

criteria.title: That message asks whether the scale target uses calendar-day or rolling-24-hour D1.

cases.prompt: Preserve the current workflow statuses of ORB-2 and ORB-3.
sources: ORB-2 is In Progress. ORB-3 is In Validation.

criteria.title: The Agent leaves ORB-2 In Progress and ORB-3 In Validation.
criteria.justification: The Agent must preserve both states.

cases.prompt: Leave ORB-2 In Progress and add a comment explaining the validation decision.

criteria.title: The Agent adds a comment to ORB-2 explaining that validation continues.
criteria.justification: The prompt requests the decision comment.

cases.prompt: Tell the team the decision and next step.
sources: The decision is to hold expansion. The next step is a retention-definition clarification.

criteria.title: The Agent tells the team that expansion is on hold and retention-definition clarification is next.
The Agent tells the team expansion is on hold.
The Agent tells the team retention-definition clarification is next.

cases.prompt: Ask the owner of the scale target which D1 definition it uses.
sources: Maya set the scale target and owns its definition. Iris is an analyst who asked Maya to clarify it.

criteria.title: The Agent asks Iris which D1 definition the scale target uses.

cases.prompt: Write the full evidence analysis into the existing project note. Tell me only the recommendation and the note link.
sources: The note must analyze a 34% D1 observation against a 45% target.

criteria.title: The Agent final response states the observation was 34% D1 and the target was 45%.
criteria.justification: The analysis depends on these figures.

cases.prompt: Explain that the undefined measurement basis prevents a confident D1 comparison.
sources: The target D1 basis is unspecified; calendar-day and rolling-24-hour are different.

criteria.title: The Agent explains that the undefined D1 measurement basis prevents a confident target-versus-observation comparison.
criteria.evidence: Inspect the response; it must cite the analyst message ID msg-447.

cases.prompt: State the hold decision in both the project note and the team message.
sources: The supported decision is hold expansion pending the metric definition.

criteria.title: The Agent project-note update states that expansion is on hold pending the metric definition.
The Agent team message states that expansion is on hold pending the metric definition.
